reference_sql:
WITH plans AS (  -- one row per subscription, with its user's first start, first plan and latest plan
  SELECT user_id,
         MIN(start_date) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id) AS first_start,
         FIRST_VALUE(plan_name) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY start_date
                                      ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS first_plan,
         LAST_VALUE(plan_name) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY start_date
                                     ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS latest_plan
  FROM subscriptions
),
users AS (  -- one row per user
  SELECT DISTINCT user_id, first_start, first_plan, latest_plan
  FROM plans
)
SELECT first_plan, latest_plan, COUNT(*) AS users
FROM users
WHERE first_start BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY first_plan, latest_plan
alternatives:
WITH bounds AS (  -- one row per user: the first and the latest start date
  SELECT user_id, MIN(start_date) AS first_start, MAX(start_date) AS latest_start
  FROM subscriptions
  GROUP BY user_id
)
SELECT f.plan_name AS first_plan, l.plan_name AS latest_plan, COUNT(*) AS users
FROM bounds b
JOIN subscriptions f ON f.user_id = b.user_id AND f.start_date = b.first_start
JOIN subscriptions l ON l.user_id = b.user_id AND l.start_date = b.latest_start
WHERE b.first_start BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY f.plan_name, l.plan_name

SELECT u.first_plan, u.latest_plan, COUNT(*) AS users
FROM (
  -- one row per user
  SELECT DISTINCT user_id,
         MIN(start_date) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id) AS first_start,
         FIRST_VALUE(plan_name) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY start_date
                                      ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS first_plan,
         FIRST_VALUE(plan_name) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY start_date DESC
                                      ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS latest_plan
  FROM subscriptions
) AS u
WHERE u.first_start BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY u.first_plan, u.latest_plan

solver.query:
WITH s AS (
  SELECT user_id, plan_name, start_date,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY start_date ASC) AS rn_first,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY start_date DESC) AS rn_last
  FROM subscriptions
), f AS (
  SELECT f.user_id, f.plan_name AS first_plan, l.plan_name AS latest_plan
  FROM s f
  JOIN s l ON l.user_id = f.user_id AND l.rn_last = 1
  WHERE f.rn_first = 1
    AND f.start_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND f.start_date <= DATE '2025-12-31'
)
SELECT first_plan, latest_plan, COUNT(*) AS users
FROM f
GROUP BY first_plan, latest_plan
